d: We are seeking a Senior Commissioning Engineer to join our team in Riyadh. In this role you will be responsible for all aspects of commissioning for the communication equipment deployed in different projects within the Kingdom. You will lead all activities related to commissioning including coordination of site mobilization, managing all aspects of site construction, interfacing with customers, scheduling resources.
q: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent experience.
Minimum 5 years’ experience working on DWDM, MPLS-TP & SDH systems including their NMS (Network Management Systems) for different vendors.
Experience with commissioning and start-up procedures for telecom equipment.
Excellent communication skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
Ability to travel frequently (>75%) within region/country and internationally as required.
Willingness to work in challenging outdoor environments.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Outlook Experience of working on Huawei MPLS-TP & DWDM systems.
Experience of working on Huawei MPLS-TP & DWDM network management systems.
Experience of working on Infinera MPLS-TP systems.
Experience of working on Infinera MPLS-TP network management systems.
Experience of working on Hitachi Energy telecommunication systems and OTN systems will be an added bonus.
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.
